items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I rented a set of drums to carry along with me so he'd have drums to play.

ctx.x: He was afraid he couldn't get back home. Most people tell that he just played bass drum, but he played the whole drum set. Oh, yes, yes, he was good.
I rented a set of drums to carry along with me so he'd have drums to play. He had a bass drum, but he didn't have the output, you know.

The funniest thing about it is when we came here with our band, we thought the band could set in the pit. We didn't know, you know, about the union. We had a union. And so they said, your band can't play. So Mac said, well, I'll put them on the stage. They're the best performers. They can play. Yes. And so that's what started. Then Bruce came in. You know Bruce? You heard of Bruce? I can't remember. He had his show too. Then he was the second with the orchestra on the stage.
